title: SymbolicsTalk28June2012
summary: Kalman Reti, one of the last Symbolics developers, gives a roughly hour-long talk on Symbolics Lisp machines. It covers the machines and their environment from an insider's perspective.
why: HN recommends it to anyone curious about Lisp machines, since it comes from someone who worked at Symbolics.

quote.text: If you only have 15 minutes, he gives another demo here
